shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Gun-handle plunger with a trigger; also fires the video skill shot. The thumb button is the Smart Missile, not a launch control.

shots.name: Turbo Bumpers
shots.notes: Three bumpers on the left side; a clean plunge lands here. Rotates the flashing Computer Screen when Control Room is dark, and counts as the Visitor's Center shot in a few specific rounds.

shots.name: Boat Dock
shots.notes: Back-right saucer, fed from the upper right flipper's half-orbit. Spots a species target when the left inlane lights it; launches the second ball for Raptor Two-Ball.

shots.name: Power Shed
shots.notes: Small scoop above the upper right flipper. Relights Control Room indefinitely and is the S in CHAOS.

shots.name: Ramp
shots.notes: Runs across the back of the game and returns to either inlane. Lights Mr. DNA, builds the T-Rex Bounty, and is the O in CHAOS.

shots.name: Raptor Pit
shots.notes: Narrow near-vertical lane that kicks the ball back toward the flippers at speed. Starts Tri-Ball once it's lit; the Danger light doubles as its ball saver.

shots.name: Egg
shots.notes: Captive ball left of the Raptor Pit. Repeated hits crack it open for escalating awards.

shots.name: T-Rex Paddock
shots.notes: Lowered triangular area feeding a saucer beneath it. Spells T-REX toward the Paddock Jackpot and eats the ball whenever it's fed.

shots.name: Species Targets
shots.notes: Six green-and-red standups scattered around the pop bumper gate and outlanes. Clearing all six lights Tri-Ball.

shots.name: Spitter Targets
shots.notes: Three-target bank beneath Hammond's Bunker, facing right. Only meaningfully used during the Spitter Attack round.

shots.name: Hammond's Bunker
shots.notes: Scoop above the left slingshot. Awards Park Revenue or lights Mr. DNA; the C in CHAOS.

shots.name: Control Room
shots.notes: Scoop above the left flipper. Collects whichever Computer Screen is flashing; the A in CHAOS.

shots.name: Visitor's Center
shots.notes: Left orbit through the Turbo Bumpers to the upper right flipper. Needs the first rollover switch tripped for Advance X credit; the H in CHAOS.

shots.name: Helicopter Pad
shots.notes: Loop shot from the upper right flipper around the back of the game and back to the same flipper. Holds the Raptor Pit value across two straight shots.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Briefly lights the Boat Dock for a species-target spot.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Lights Advance X at the Visitor's Center and, for a few seconds, Control Room.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: No rubber, no kickback — a bare drain. Carries the Special light when lit.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Carries the Special light when lit; slightly better protected than the left side.

shots.name: Upper Right Flipper
shots.notes: Second-stage flipper on the right button. Shoots the Helicopter Pad loop and lines up Boat Dock returns toward T-Rex.

goals.title: Skill Shot: Stun The Dinosaur
goals.summary: A video-game skill shot: a dinosaur paces back and forth on the display, and you fire the trigger the instant it steps into your sights. The value climbs with the ball number.
goals.reward: 2M on ball one, 3M on ball two, 4M on ball three; a miss pays a tenth of that, and a hit unlocks Super Pops the moment the ball reaches the Turbo Bumpers.

steps.action: Full plunge and fire the trigger the instant the dinosaur crosses your sights
steps.detail: Lead it slightly — balls two and three add a brief pause meant to bait an early pull. A clean hit rides straight into the Turbo Bumpers for Super Pops.

goals.title: Tri-Ball: Light, Start, First Jackpot
goals.summary: The game's headline multiball: clear the six scattered species targets to light it, taunt the Raptor Pit to start it, then take either Jackpot to open the door to CHAOS.
goals.reward: Ramp Jackpot starts around 15M; the Helicopter Pad's Double Jackpot pays more. Collecting either one immediately starts the first CHAOS.

steps.action: Clear the six scattered species targets
steps.detail: Any hit counts toward all six; a lit Boat Dock spots one for you, and the game spots a few automatically if you're still short heading into ball three.

steps.action: Taunt the Raptor Pit to start Tri-Ball
steps.detail: 3 hits opens the first Tri-Ball, 5 the second, 7 the third — after that, only feeding T-Rex will start it.

steps.action: Shoot the Ramp for the Jackpot
steps.detail: Every switch hit while Tri-Ball runs adds to both Jackpot values, so a fast first shot protects it from a ball loss.

steps.action: Or loop the Helicopter Pad for the Double Jackpot
steps.detail: Worth more than the Ramp alone; either shot ends this phase and drops you straight into CHAOS.

goals.title: Spell CHAOS
goals.summary: Collecting either Jackpot opens the first CHAOS: five scoops and shots, each spotting one letter for 5M. Complete the set with at least two balls still up and six-ball play begins.
goals.reward: 5M per letter, plus 10M for finishing the set — completion launches six-ball play.

steps.action: Sink Hammond's Bunker for the C
Feed the Turbo Bumpers for the H
steps.detail: Any bumper hit counts here.

steps.action: Drop into the Control Room for the A
Loop the Ramp for the O
steps.detail: Usually the hardest of the five with balls bouncing everywhere.

steps.action: Find the Power Shed for the S
steps.detail: Often blocked by the upper right flipper — worth saving for a moment it's clear.

goals.title: Six-Ball CHAOS & Twin Super Jackpots
goals.summary: Six-ball CHAOS pays double, and finishing it a second time feeds T-Rex for 50M and lights twin Super Jackpots worth up to 600M between the two of them.
goals.reward: 10M per CHAOS letter, 50M for feeding T-Rex, then twin Super Jackpots — the Ramp starts at 600M minus 100M for every ball already drained, and the Helicopter Pad adds another Jackpot's worth on top.

steps.action: Spell the C again
Spell the H again
Spell the A again
Spell the O again
Spell the S again
steps.detail: This pass pays 10M a letter instead of 5M.

steps.action: Feed T-Rex for 50M
steps.detail: Needs at least two balls still on the playfield — trap what you can on the lower right flipper first, since every ball you lose costs the coming Super Jackpots 100M.

steps.action: Collect the Super Jackpot
Or take the matching Super Jackpot on the loop
steps.detail: Collecting one leaves the other lit — grab both if you can hold two balls in play, and the whole CHAOS-and-T-Rex loop repeats.

goals.title: The Eleven Computer Screens
goals.summary: Every ball starts with Control Room lit for one of eleven timed rounds, and clearing all eleven is the other half of this game's scoring, alongside Tri-Ball.
instructions: Control Room lights automatically at the start of every ball, and shooting Power Shed relights it any time after that
Either Inlane also flashes Control Room for a few seconds if the scoops feel too risky
The Turbo Bumpers spin through the eleven screens while Control Room sits dark — whichever one is flashing when you finally sink the scoop is the one you get
Stampede plays first no matter what: every switch scores an escalating 300K, with a bonus for landing T-Rex or the Galiminus target mid-round
Electric Fence asks for fifteen bumper-or-slingshot hits in twenty seconds for 30M — only worth chasing if your pops are lively
Spitter Attack pays 5M, then 10M, then 15M for three hits anywhere on the Spitter bank beneath Hammond's Bunker, the safest 30M in the game
System Boot lights all three scoops at once for 5M, 10M, then 15M — sinking one here can also relight and collect the next screen in the same motion
Raptors' Rampage and Mosquito Millions pay small, escalating amounts for repeated hits on the Raptor Pit or the Egg — low value, best left for when one is already flashing
Bone Busting wants three Ramp shots in twenty seconds for 20M, a tough ask on a ramp this narrow unless you're already rolling
One screen is simply Light Extra Ball — the Boat Dock hands it straight over the moment it comes up
Clearing all eleven arms System Failure at Control Room and Power Shed; after your first System Failure, only Power Shed relights Control Room, so the Inlane shortcut disappears for the second run
goals.reward: Whichever screen is flashing — System Boot and Feed T-Rex are the easy wins, Electric Fence and Bone Busting are the traps, and the full set arms System Failure.

goals.title: Computer Screen: Escape Isla Nubar
goals.summary: The richest single Computer Screen: three shots — Boat Dock, Helicopter Pad, and the Turbo Bumpers — pay a counting-down value and re-arm each other as long as you keep landing them.
goals.reward: Starts at 21M counting down by 1M a second; each hit banks the current value and adds 10M back to the pool, typically worth 70-90M when chained cleanly.

steps.action: Collect Escape Isla Nubar when it's the flashing screen
steps.detail: It has no shot of its own to start — sink the lit Control Room while this is the screen on deck.

steps.action: Trap on the upper flipper and take the Boat Dock first
steps.detail: The safest of the three shots to open with.

steps.action: Follow with the Helicopter Pad
steps.detail: Feeds right back to the same flipper for the next shot.

steps.action: Finish by feeding the Turbo Bumpers
steps.detail: Just reaching the pops counts here — you don't need the full orbit around.

goals.title: Computer Screen: Feed T-Rex
goals.summary: The most straightforward Computer Screen on the list: thirty seconds to put the ball in front of T-Rex.

steps.action: Collect Feed T-Rex when it's the flashing screen
Make the shot within 30 seconds
steps.detail: No other requirement — one clean hit ends the round and books the 30M.

goals.title: Raptor Two-Ball
goals.summary: A quick two-ball round: the Boat Dock launches a second ball, and every Raptor Pit hit after that pays an escalating Jackpot.
goals.reward: Jackpots starting around 7M and climbing roughly 2M a hit.

steps.action: Collect Raptor Two-Ball when it's the flashing screen
Shoot the lit Boat Dock to launch the second ball
steps.detail: Starting Two-Ball cuts short whatever other Computer Screen round you had running.

steps.action: Work the Raptor Pit for repeat Jackpots
steps.detail: The ball saver only covers roughly the first ten seconds — after that, a drained ball stays gone.

goals.title: Mr. DNA's Menu
goals.summary: Ramp shots light Mr. DNA at Hammond's Bunker, offering a choice of three awards you pick with the flippers.
instructions: Light Mr. DNA at Hammond's Bunker by racking up Ramp shots — the first one needs only a few, and each later one costs a couple more
Once it's lit, three awards cycle past on the display
Flip a flipper or pull the trigger the instant the one you want is highlighted — waiting for a second pass through the list is safer than grabbing the first
Point awards and Runaway Score are always solid picks
Complete Egg advances your captive-ball egg toward its next crack without the risk of shooting it yourself
Later in the game, Lite Tri-Ball and Lite Special turn up in the rotation — either beats a plain point value
goals.reward: A free pick from Mr. DNA's menu, repeatable all game — each award nudges you toward Tri-Ball, an Egg, or a chunk of points without a risky shot.

goals.title: Victory Lap
goals.summary: Earning a replay lights the Ramp for thirty seconds of Victory Lap — six shots, with the last one paying far more than the rest.
goals.reward: 5M for each of the first five Ramp shots, 25M for the sixth — 50M total if you clear it.

steps.action: Rip the Ramp six times before the 30-second timer runs out
steps.detail: The first five pay 5M each; the sixth alone is worth 25M. Every other timer you had running pauses until Victory Lap ends.

goals.title: The Smart Missile
goals.summary: One button, one use per game, and it collects everything lit or flashing on the playfield the instant you press it.
instructions: You get exactly one Smart Missile for the entire game — there's no way to earn a second
Press its button and it instantly collects everything currently lit or flashing

It fires the next Computer Screen if Tri-Ball isn't lit, lights or starts Tri-Ball outright, collects Jackpots and Escape values, and — its best use — both twin Super Jackpots at once during six-ball CHAOS

It will not touch Runaway awards, Mr. DNA's menu, Park Revenue, the T-REX letters or Bounty, either hold award on the Ramp or Helicopter Pad, the Combo shots, or a lit Boat Dock — though it does spot every species target as a consolation
An outlane trip disables it until a successful Death Save re-enables it, so don't count on it mid-drain
Best saved for forcing Tri-Ball on ball three if you still haven't lit it, or for six-ball CHAOS and the twin Super Jackpots, where its payout is largest
goals.reward: Instant credit for every lit award on the playfield — save it for six-ball CHAOS and it can be worth several hundred million in one press.

goals.title: Death Save
goals.summary: Trip an outlane sensor and recover before the ball reaches the trough, and the game rewards you for it.
instructions: Any time in single-ball play an outlane sensor trips and then another switch closes before the ball lands in the trough, you've pulled off a Death Save
The display morphs a T-Rex skeleton into a living one and pays 3M
A Bang Back — nudging the machine as the ball drains — can trigger the same save, though it risks rattling the coin door
The Smart Missile can't help here — outlane sensors disable it the moment they trip, and only the save itself brings it back
goals.reward: 3M, one of the game's better animations, and your ball back.

goals.title: Combo: Ramp → Boat Dock → Helicopter Pad → T-Rex
goals.summary: The game's acknowledged combo: a Ramp shot that comes back through the Boat Dock, straight on to the Helicopter Pad, and — if you're feeling bold — right into T-Rex after that.
goals.reward: 5M for the three-shot combo, another 10M if you extend it into T-Rex.

steps.action: Shoot the Ramp
Let the return feed the Boat Dock
steps.detail: The kickout lands you on the upper right flipper.

steps.action: Finish with the Helicopter Pad
steps.detail: Completes the base 5M combo.

steps.action: Extend it into T-Rex for the bonus
steps.detail: An extra 10M if you keep the chain alive one shot further.

goals.title: Shoot Out
goals.summary: A random in-play video mode, unrelated to your opening skill shot: a dinosaur jogs across the display, and you fire the trigger to stun it.
instructions: At random points during play, a dinosaur jogs across the display in front of a machine gun — that's the Shoot Out
Grab the trigger and fire four or five times to stun it for 3M
The grace period is generous, and if the animation has already ended you can still grab the trigger to restart it
Completing it turns on a gentler Super Pops — 100K a bumper, 1M for every set of three — that doesn't expire until you hit something outside the Turbo Bumpers
A lit Boat Dock shot is what spots a species target now, not the Shoot Out itself, so don't lean on this alone to build toward Tri-Ball
goals.reward: 3M plus an untimed run of Super Pops once you connect.

goals.title: Advance X: The Bonus Multiplier
goals.summary: The Right Inlane arms Advance X, and a real orbit shot to the Visitor's Center — not just a bumper graze — cashes it in for a step up the bonus ladder.
goals.reward: Multiplier climbs 1x, 3x, 6x, 9x; two straight Ramp shots hold both bonus and multiplier into the next ball, though the base bonus itself caps at 2M (18M at 9x).

steps.action: Roll the Right Inlane to arm Advance X
Send a real orbit shot up the Visitor's Center
steps.detail: This one needs the actual first rollover switch tripped — credit from merely reaching the bumpers doesn't count here.

steps.action: Hit the Ramp twice in a row to hold it over
steps.detail: Banks your bonus and multiplier for the start of the next ball.

goals.title: Strategy: The Low-Risk Opener
goals.summary: Work the video skill shot, lean on the Inlanes to light Control Room instead of the guarded Power Shed, and let the Boat Dock do your Tri-Ball qualifying for you.

steps.action: Fire the skill shot on your first plunge
steps.detail: Lead the trigger slightly; a clean hit is worth 2-4M depending on ball number and drops you straight into Super Pops.

steps.action: Take the Inlane feeds over risky scoops early
steps.detail: Both Inlanes light Control Room for a few seconds — safer than threading the guarded Power Shed while you're still learning the flipper gaps.

steps.action: Cash in whatever Computer Screen is flashing
steps.detail: Skip Electric Fence and Bone Busting if you can help it; System Boot and Feed T-Rex are the friendliest early wins.

steps.action: Let the lit Boat Dock spot species targets for you
steps.detail: The passive route to lighting Tri-Ball — no need to hunt down every scattered target yourself.

goals.title: Strategy: Bank The Missile, Chase Six-Ball CHAOS
goals.summary: The score-chasing line: keep working Computer Screens toward System Failure, push into Tri-Ball for CHAOS, and save the Smart Missile for six-ball play, where it's worth the most.

steps.action: Clear Computer Screens toward System Failure
steps.detail: A lively set of Turbo Bumpers alone can carry System Failure to 150M, so don't neglect this track just because Tri-Ball is flashier.

steps.action: Light Tri-Ball at the scattered species targets
Taunt the Raptor Pit to start it
Take the first Jackpot fast to reach CHAOS
Or take the Double Jackpot on the loop instead
Spell CHAOS, then spell it again in six-ball play
steps.detail: Save the Smart Missile for whichever pass is giving you trouble — it's worth far more here than on a single Jackpot.

steps.action: Feed T-Rex with as many balls trapped as you can manage
steps.detail: Every ball still in play when you make this shot adds 100M to the Super Jackpots waiting behind it.

goals.title: System Failure
goals.summary: Clearing all eleven Computer Screens arms System Failure at Control Room and Power Shed: forty-five seconds of six-ball chaos where every switch pays 1M.
goals.reward: Roughly 1M per switch closure for 45 seconds — a lively set of Turbo Bumpers alone can be worth 100-150M.

steps.action: Sink either flashing scoop to start the 45-second round
steps.detail: Control Room or Power Shed both work once all eleven screens are cleared.

steps.action: Park the ball in the Turbo Bumpers and keep it moving
steps.detail: The busiest, highest-value spot for the full 45 seconds; drained balls relaunch automatically until the timer runs out.

achievements.title: Stunned On Sight
achievements.desc: Land the video skill shot by firing the trigger the instant the dinosaur crosses your sights.

achievements.title: Full Throttle Bonus
achievements.desc: Arm and collect Advance X at the Visitor's Center to step up the bonus multiplier.

achievements.title: Not Today
achievements.desc: Pull off a Death Save by recovering the ball after an outlane sensor trips.

achievements.title: Dinner Is Served
achievements.desc: Feed T-Rex within the 30-second window during its own Computer Screen round.

achievements.title: DNA Discovered
achievements.desc: Light Mr. DNA at Hammond's Bunker and choose an award off the menu.

achievements.title: Dual Jackpot Opened
achievements.desc: Start Tri-Ball and collect a Jackpot at the Ramp or Helicopter Pad.

achievements.title: Spell It Out
achievements.desc: Complete the first CHAOS sequence to launch six-ball play.

achievements.title: Off The Island
achievements.desc: Chain Boat Dock, Helicopter Pad, and the Turbo Bumpers to run up the Escape Isla Nubar total.

achievements.title: Four-Shot Combo
achievements.desc: Chain Ramp into Boat Dock into Helicopter Pad into T-Rex in one run.

achievements.title: Surprise Gunfight
achievements.desc: Catch the random Shoot Out video mode and stun the dinosaur.

achievements.title: Double Trouble
achievements.desc: Launch Raptor Two-Ball and bank at least one escalating Jackpot.

achievements.title: Six In A Row
achievements.desc: Clear all six Victory Lap ramp shots inside the 30-second window.

achievements.title: Total System Failure
achievements.desc: Clear all eleven Computer Screens and trigger the six-ball System Failure round.

achievements.title: Eleven Screens Down
achievements.desc: Collect every one of the eleven Computer Screens across a single game.

achievements.title: One Shot, Everything
achievements.desc: Fire the Smart Missile at its best possible moment during six-ball CHAOS.

achievements.title: Twin Super Jackpots
achievements.desc: Reach six-ball CHAOS a second time, feed T-Rex, and collect both Super Jackpots.
